messages.subject: Re: How to design a upload file ui with Shiny
parts:
You can read some early docs here, it will work with today's Shiny 0.4.0 but only locally and only semi-reliably (works best with Chrome). With Shiny 0.4.0 it doesn't work at all with Shiny Server.

Next week we'll make beta versions of Shiny and Shiny Server available where this stuff all works much, much better (though still not with IE9 and earlier).
